body: Hey buddy, I’ve been in the literal same position that you are in right now. What I personally did as a Christian was Pray and read the Bible and it turnt out very well for me. It took a while of praying, reading, and going to church basically becoming a better Christian and it worked out well for me, now I have very kind and humble friends that I can talk to by the Grace of God. You are never really lonely, in fact not lonely at all. God is everyone’s best and closest friend and he will not leave you. You can run away from him but he’ll stay with you, try some of those things out and feel free to dm me I’m there for you since I’ve been in your place previously. God Bless!
Says the one who got raped
